title: Chickpea & Spinach Coconut Curry
ingredients: Salt, to taste; rice to serve
instructions: Heat the garlic-infused oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the curry powder and ginger, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk, stir to combine, bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the chickpeas, simmer uncovered 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and serve over rice. If IBS is unsettled, serve a smaller chickpea portion and top up with extra sauce and rice instead.

title: Red Lentil Dahl
ingredients: Salt, to taste; rice to serve
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot, add the turmeric and cumin, stir 30 seconds.
Add the carrots, cook 3-4 minutes to soften slightly.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, and water or stock. Bring to the boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered 18-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft and the mixture has thickened.
Stir in the spinach or kale for the final 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and serve over rice.

title: Quinoa & Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 tin black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190C (170C fan) / Gas Mark 5.
Cook the quinoa according to packet instructions, then drain and set aside.
Mix cooked quinoa with black beans, sweetcorn, cumin, smoked paprika, 1 tbsp oil, and salt.
Arrange pepper halves cut-side up in a baking dish, drizzle with remaining oil.
Spoon the quinoa mixture into each pepper half, pressing down gently.
Cover loosely with foil, bake 20 minutes, then uncover and bake a further 5 minutes.

title: Mince Stir-Fry
baseIngredients: 300g frozen stir-fry veg (or sliced carrots + peppers)

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, brown the mince 6-7 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add half the veg and half the ginger, cook 3-4 minutes until just tender.
Stir in half the coconut aminos, cook 1 minute, serve over rice.

hers.protein: 2 x 250g pouches cooked puy or green lentils
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a second pan, add the lentils, heat through 2-3 minutes.
Add the remaining veg and ginger, cook 3-4 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the remaining coconut aminos, cook 1 minute, serve over rice.

title: Sheet Pan Roast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200C (180C fan) / Gas Mark 6.
Toss the sweet potato and broccoli or green beans in olive oil, paprika, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Place on one half of the tray, roast 30-35 minutes until cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

hers.protein: 1 tin butter beans, drained and patted dry
instructions: Toss in a little oil and paprika, add to the tray for the final 15-18 minutes only.
Roast until lightly golden at the edges.

title: Garlic-Infused Oil Pan-Fry
baseIngredients: Garlic-infused oil, 1 lemon, chilli flakes, rice to serve
instructions: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add prawns, cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Squeeze over lemon and chilli flakes, serve over rice.

hers.protein: 1 tin cannellini beans, drained and patted dry
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a second pan over medium-high heat.
Add the beans, cook 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Squeeze over lemon and chilli flakes, serve over rice.

title: Baked Salmon + Roasted Veg
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C (180C fan) / Gas Mark 6.
Place salmon and asparagus/green beans on a lined tray, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt.
Squeeze half a lemon over the top, tuck the other half's slices among the salmon.
Roast 15-18 minutes until the salmon flakes easily with a fork.

title: Baked Eggs in Tomato Sauce (Shakshuka-style)
ingredients: Wheat-free bread or flatbread to serve
instructions: Heat oil in a wide pan, add sliced pepper, cook 4-5 minutes until softening.
Add smoked paprika and cumin, stir 30 seconds.
Add chopped tomatoes, simmer 8-10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Make 4 small wells in the sauce, crack an egg into each.
Cover, cook 6-8 minutes over low-medium heat until whites are set and yolks still soft.
Serve with wheat-free bread or flatbread.

title: Turkey Mince Chilli
ingredients: 1 tin black beans, drained and rinsed
1 tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot, brown the mince, 6-7 minutes.
Add chilli powder and cumin, stir 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes and beans, bring to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered 15-20 minutes until thickened. Serve over rice, keeping the bean portion modest if IBS is unsettled.

title: Butter Bean & Kale Stew
ingredients: 2 tins butter beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat oil in a pot, add smoked paprika, stir 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes and butter beans, bring to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered 15 minutes, mashing a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken.
Stir in kale for the final 3-4 minutes until wilted. Season and serve, with rice if you like.
